title: OliveSoft overview
text: OliveSoft is a Data & AI consulting firm founded in 2018 in Paris, France. It helps organizations with data integration, BI and dashboarding, AI development, the Salesforce ecosystem and data platforms. Tagline: 'Votre partenaire Data & IA'. Its core expertise is in retail and fashion, and it is expanding to other demanding industries.

title: Locations and footprint
text: OliveSoft headquarters: Paris, France. Operational hubs: Tunis and Sfax (Tunisia) and Dubai (United Arab Emirates). Clients are served across America, Asia, Europe and Africa. The company positions itself as combining Parisian roots and Mediterranean heritage (the olive tree as a symbol of endurance) with a global outlook.

title: Key figures
text: OliveSoft key figures from its website: 8+ years of experience, 250+ projects delivered, 60+ enterprise clients, 60+ employees and a network of 75 partners. Service promises: reduce data errors and bugs by 50%, reduce data operations and management costs by 30%, meet 100% of project goals and requirements.

title: Values and culture
text: OliveSoft's four values: Trust & Mutual Support (a safe-to-fail environment), Resilient Commitment (turning pressure into opportunity), Collective Craftsmanship (technical mastery plus shared responsibility) and Adaptive Excellence (versatility, initiative, local insight with a global vision). The company stresses a human-centered approach and training future leaders internally.

title: Sustainability: EcoVadis and Net Zero 2040
text: OliveSoft holds an EcoVadis Silver medal (top 15% worldwide) for environmental impact, social practices and ethical conduct. It publicly committed to net-zero greenhouse gas emissions across operations and value chain by 2040, aligned with the Paris Agreement 1.5C goal. Actions: 100% renewable energy for hubs and offices, sustainable and energy-efficient software architectures, Green Code R&D, verified carbon offsets for residual emissions, and annual progress reports. Aligned with UN SDGs 9, 11 and 4.

title: Industry focus
text: Industry expertise highlighted by OliveSoft: Retail/Distribution (data and systems optimization, inventory management, customer experience), E-commerce (platform integration and data analysis) and Fashion (agile data-driven solutions improving supply chain visibility and customer relationships). Luxury is also a core segment of its client base.

title: Service: Data Integration
text: Data Integration: secure and reliable ETL or ELT pipelines, API-based automation, real-time or batch synchronization across on-premise, cloud and hybrid systems, with attention to data quality, consistency and security. Business value: removes silos, unified real-time view, automated processes, accurate reporting. Tools: Talend, SSIS (Microsoft), MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, n8n.

title: Service: BI & Dashboarding
text: BI & Dashboarding: data modeling, KPI definition, advanced visualization, and semantic layers on top of ERP, CRM, cloud services and databases, for finance, operations, marketing and HR teams. Tools: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, Google Data Studio / Looker Studio.

title: Service: AI Development
text: AI Development: end-to-end AI projects covering ideation, data preparation, model development, testing, deployment and monitoring. Technologies: machine learning, deep learning, NLP, computer vision and generative AI. Solutions are designed to be scalable, explainable and integrated into existing processes. Use cases: automating repetitive tasks, anomaly detection, customer personalization, logistics optimization, demand forecasting. AI tooling listed on the site: Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, LangGraph, n8n, BigQuery.

title: Service: Salesforce Ecosystem
text: Salesforce Ecosystem: implementation, customization and API integration of Salesforce with the client's information system. Clouds: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Experience Cloud, Commerce Cloud, CRM and CRM Analytics. Automation via Flow, Apex and Lightning, plus platform governance. Goal: a 360-degree customer view, better lead tracking and automated service interactions. OliveSoft is listed as a Salesforce Integration Partner.

title: Service: Data Platform
text: Data Platform: design and management of modern scalable data infrastructure including data lakes, data warehouses and data marts on cloud or on-premise, covering ingestion, storage, catalog management and data governance. Technologies: Snowflake, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Apache Kafka.

text: Technologies mastered by OliveSoft teams: Integration/automation: MuleSoft, Boomi, Talend, SSIS, Workato, Make, Power Automate, n8n. Cloud/data: Google Cloud Platform, BigQuery, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, Apache Kafka, Dataform. BI: Power BI, Tableau, Qlik Sense, Looker Studio. CRM: Salesforce. AI: Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, LangGraph, CoAtNet, FAISS. ERP/HR systems seen in projects: Sage X3, Cegid, SAP SuccessFactors, Talent Connect.

title: Retail/e-commerce unified customer CRM on GCP (Cegid, BigQuery, Power BI)
text: Client: major retail and e-commerce brand (unnamed). Problem: customer data scattered across systems and formats, campaigns based on assumptions. Solution: centralized CRM on Google Cloud Platform and BigQuery. Daily automated pipelines ingest the Cegid ERP, e-commerce back-end, marketing platforms and support tools; data was cleaned, deduplicated and standardized. Custom segmentation by value, engagement and purchase frequency. Power BI dashboards for marketing and sales (weekly sales, customer activity, campaign performance, year-over-year). Flow: ERP to GCP to BigQuery to Power BI. Published July 2025.

title: New Fashion CRM platform rebuild (GCP, Power BI)
text: Client: New Fashion (fashion retail and e-commerce). Problem: first Customer Data Platform on GCP had inconsistent KPIs, weak duplicate handling and traceability, missing customers, unstable business rules and scalability issues. Solution in six steps: clean and standardize data; precise duplicate detection with a unique stable CRM ID; enriched 360-degree customer profiles; address harmonization (over 3 million addresses fixed, with rules by customer type); KPI recalculation with explicit business rules (channel, Lifetime Value); Power BI reports rebuilt. Results: unified customer view, nearly 1 million additional prospects integrated, scalable architecture, full change history for audit and compliance, full documentation. Google Analytics integration added. Published July 2025.

title: Demand forecasting and AI dashboards for a raw-materials supplier (Sage X3, BigQuery, Power BI)
text: Client: leading raw-materials sourcing company for manufacturing industry (unnamed). Goals: raise supply-chain service rate from 20% to 60%, cut procurement costs by 20% through better demand forecasting, cut storage costs by 15%. Solution: Sage X3 ERP integrated with Google Cloud Storage; Dataform pipelines to build clean reusable data layers; BigQuery for analytics; time-series models (R&D phase) to forecast demand, adjust raw-material orders and project revenue by business unit; Power BI dashboards for sales, finance, purchasing, logistics and planning. Published July 2025.

title: Global HR information system with MuleSoft (SAP SuccessFactors)
text: Client: multinational organization (unnamed). Solution: centralized international HRIS (SIRH) integrating SAP SuccessFactors, Talent Connect and local payroll systems through MuleSoft, with bidirectional real-time data flows. Build phase: needs analysis, over 15 MuleSoft applications for region and division specific logic, CI/CD pipeline, unit, integration, system and performance testing, environment-specific deployments (dev, staging, production), hyper-care after go-live. Run phase fully operated by OliveSoft: monitoring dashboards, logging, access management, regular daily and monthly checks, incident handling, documentation, rollout to new regions. Published July 2025.

title: AI counterfeit and grey-market detection PoC (CoAtNet, FAISS)
text: Proof of concept for luxury and retail brands to detect suspicious listings on second-hand and social platforms such as Vinted, Leboncoin and Facebook Marketplace; luxury counterfeiting is estimated at around 15 billion euros of lost revenue per year. Method: crawl listings (images and metadata), preprocess images, encode with CoAtNet (fine-tunable) into embeddings, index in FAISS and compare with authentic industrial designs using cosine or L2 similarity and an adaptive threshold. Human-in-the-loop review for roughly 5-10% of detections. Agents suggest Locarno classification and produce multi-source risk scores. Challenges: image quality, AI-generated photos, false positives, GDPR. Published December 2025.

title: AI-powered intellectual property registration platform (government agency)
text: Client: government agency (unnamed). Solution: end-to-end intelligent platform to simplify and unify trademark and patent registration. Core components: an AI chatbot guiding users through each registration step, and an intelligent analysis robot that detects similar existing entries to strengthen originality and avoid duplicates. Aim: smoother administrative processes and better protection of innovation at national scale.
